cards.title: Tidepool Timekeepers Lab Contrast Pair
cards.sentenceVarietySkill: write a sentence pair with contrast
cards.useCase: Adult-led printable paper sleeve sentence-variety card for building a contrasting fictional tidepool sentence pair on paper: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Adult: set this card beside blank paper and one pretend sleeve strip, then offer a broad tidepool lab idea: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Writer: write one short tidepool sentence, stretch the next line with a contrast, and keep both ideas invented: ____________________.
cards.shortSentencePrompt: Short sentence: write one clear line about a shell dial, pool marker, or tide bead: ____________________.
cards.longSentencePrompt: Stretched sentence: add one useful contrast after but or while without crowding the line: ____________________.
cards.questionSentencePrompt: Question sentence: ask what changed between the first line and the second line: ____________________.
cards.starterSwapPrompt: Starter swap: begin the contrast line with Instead, Meanwhile, or By the shell dial: ____________________.
cards.sentenceCombinePrompt: Sentence combine: join The pool was calm and The shell dial clicked into one contrast sentence: ____________________.
cards.rhythmCheckPrompt: Rhythm check: mark whether the short line followed by the contrast line sounds clear: ____________________.
cards.finalLinePrompt: Final line: copy the tidepool sentence pair that shows contrast without extra words: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: write only the short line and one contrast word: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Carry-on line: make a new tidepool sentence pair where the second line changes the first idea: ____________________.

cards.title: Revision River Ferry One-Idea Trim
cards.sentenceVarietySkill: trim a sentence back to one idea
cards.useCase: Adult-led printable paper sleeve sentence-variety card for trimming one fictional ferry sentence back to a single clear idea: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Adult: place this card beside blank paper and one pretend sleeve strip, then offer a broad draft-ferry idea: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Writer: write a crowded ferry sentence, choose the one idea that matters most, and trim the rest: ____________________.
cards.shortSentencePrompt: Short sentence: write the one idea the ferry sign needs to keep: ____________________.
cards.longSentencePrompt: Stretched sentence: write the crowded version with two invented details so you can trim it: ____________________.
cards.questionSentencePrompt: Question sentence: ask which detail is doing the clearest job: ____________________.
cards.starterSwapPrompt: Starter swap: begin with the ferry marker, the draft oar, or the folded sign: ____________________.
cards.sentenceCombinePrompt: Sentence combine: join two tiny ferry lines, then keep only the idea that carries the sentence: ____________________.
cards.rhythmCheckPrompt: Rhythm check: read the long version and the trimmed version, then mark the cleaner rhythm: ____________________.
cards.finalLinePrompt: Final line: copy the trimmed ferry sentence with one clear idea: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: cross out one extra detail and copy the sentence that remains: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Carry-on line: trim another ferry sentence so it keeps one idea: ____________________.

cards.title: Clue Label Tower Museum Order Choice
cards.useCase: Adult-led printable paper sleeve sentence-variety card for choosing the best order for one fictional museum clue sentence: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Adult: set this card beside blank paper and one pretend sleeve strip, then choose a broad museum clue: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Writer: try the same clue in two sentence orders, then choose the order that helps the line make sense: ____________________.
cards.shortSentencePrompt: Short sentence: write one clear label clue about a display drawer or pointer card: ____________________.
cards.longSentencePrompt: Stretched sentence: add one useful clue after the main action: ____________________.
cards.questionSentencePrompt: Question sentence: ask which clue the reader should notice first: ____________________.
cards.starterSwapPrompt: Starter swap: begin with First, Beside the case, or Under the pointer card: ____________________.
cards.sentenceCombinePrompt: Sentence combine: join The label tipped and The clue drawer opened in the order that makes sense: ____________________.
cards.rhythmCheckPrompt: Rhythm check: compare the two sentence orders and mark the one that reads cleanly: ____________________.
cards.finalLinePrompt: Final line: copy the museum clue sentence in its best order: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: write two starts, circle the clearer opening, and copy the line: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Carry-on line: reorder one museum sentence so the clue appears before the result: ____________________.

cards.title: Compass Craft Academy Rhythm Pair
cards.sentenceVarietySkill: compare two sentence rhythms on paper
cards.useCase: Adult-led printable paper sleeve sentence-variety card for comparing two fictional compass-craft sentence rhythms on paper: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Adult: set this card beside blank paper and two pretend sleeve strips, then keep the craft scene invented: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Writer: write two versions of one compass-craft idea, one short and one stretched, then choose the smoother rhythm: ____________________.
cards.shortSentencePrompt: Short sentence: write one crisp line about a paper needle or bead marker: ____________________.
cards.longSentencePrompt: Stretched sentence: add a useful craft detail after the action: ____________________.
cards.questionSentencePrompt: Question sentence: ask whether the short or stretched line fits the craft moment: ____________________.
cards.starterSwapPrompt: Starter swap: begin one version with Carefully, At the fold guide, or With the paper needle: ____________________.
cards.sentenceCombinePrompt: Sentence combine: join The compass card tilted and The bead marker slid into one smooth line: ____________________.
cards.rhythmCheckPrompt: Rhythm check: compare the two versions on paper and mark the sentence rhythm that feels steadier: ____________________.
cards.finalLinePrompt: Final line: copy the compass-craft sentence with the rhythm you would keep: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: label one version short and one version stretched, then copy the smoother line: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Carry-on line: make two compass-craft versions and keep the one with stronger rhythm: ____________________.

cards.title: Binding Day Boardwalk Strongest Line
cards.useCase: Adult-led printable paper sleeve sentence-variety card for choosing one strongest fictional boardwalk sentence after trying several shapes on paper: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Adult: place this card beside blank paper and a pretend sleeve strip, then choose a broad booklet-closing idea: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Writer: try a short line, a stretched line, a question, and a starter swap before copying the strongest varied sentence: ____________________.
cards.shortSentencePrompt: Short sentence: write one clear boardwalk line about a booklet clasp, page rail, or thread loop: ____________________.
cards.longSentencePrompt: Stretched sentence: add one useful boardwalk detail without adding a second idea: ____________________.
cards.questionSentencePrompt: Question sentence: ask what the page helper should choose next: ____________________.
cards.starterSwapPrompt: Starter swap: begin with Beside the booklet stand, After the page fold, or With a thread loop: ____________________.
cards.sentenceCombinePrompt: Sentence combine: join The booklet opened and The clasp waited into one smooth sentence: ____________________.
cards.rhythmCheckPrompt: Rhythm check: compare all versions and mark the line that sounds strongest on paper: ____________________.
cards.finalLinePrompt: Final line: copy the strongest varied fictional boardwalk sentence: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: choose one shape and copy only the final boardwalk line: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Carry-on line: try one new sentence shape for a boardwalk idea and copy the strongest line: ____________________.
